audit_metadata.title: Lal Kitab 1952 Teva Classification Forensic Trace Matrix
audit_metadata.auditor: Vedas Kundli Engine Integrity Verification Core

teva_rules_evaluated.source_text_hi: 11 शनि ... पिछले जन्म का साधु होगा धरमी टेवा सुख देवे जो
teva_rules_evaluated.condition: Saturn situated in House 11 unconditionally confers Dharmi Teva
teva_rules_evaluated.remedial_implications: Divine protection active; native is shielded against fatal malefic blows. Aggressive remedies prohibited.

teva_rules_evaluated.source_text_hi: सात गुरू का ... धरमी टेवा सुख देवे जो
teva_rules_evaluated.condition: Jupiter situated in House 7 confers Dharmi Teva

teva_rules_evaluated.source_text_hi: दस गुरू ... धरमी टेवा सुख देवे जो
teva_rules_evaluated.condition: Jupiter situated in House 10 confers Dharmi Teva
teva_rules_evaluated.remedial_implications: Protective shield against unforeseen career perils.

teva_rules_evaluated.source_text_hi: पाप चंद्र 10 चौथे हो ... धरमी टेवा सुख देवे जो
teva_rules_evaluated.condition: Moon in House 4 or 10 conjoined with malefic planets (Saturn, Rahu, Ketu)
teva_rules_evaluated.remedial_implications: Malefic conjunction is transmuted into protective shielding.

teva_rules_evaluated.source_text_hi: शत्रु बाहम घर 10 में बैठे टेवा होता ग्रह अंधा हो
teva_rules_evaluated.condition: Two or more mutually hostile planets co-occupying House 10
teva_rules_evaluated.remedial_implications: Native experiences directional confusion in career. Remedy: Feed 10 blind persons by daylight.

teva_rules_evaluated.source_text_hi: सूर्य घर 7 ... टेवा रतौंधी होता हो
teva_rules_evaluated.condition: Sun occupying House 7 creates Night-Blindness Teva
teva_rules_evaluated.remedial_implications: Judgment wavers after twilight. Forbid financial decisions after sunset.

teva_rules_evaluated.condition: Saturn in House 7 paired with Sun in House 4
teva_rules_evaluated.remedial_implications: Evening vulnerability; strictly avoid night-time contracts.

teva_rules_evaluated.source_text_hi: ख़ाली मुट्ठी, या बुध पापी वां असर नाबालिग़ देता हो / साल गुज़रते 12 जो
teva_rules_evaluated.condition: Native age under 12, all 4 Kendras (1, 4, 7, 10) vacant (Empty Fist), or Mercury conjoined with malefics
teva_rules_evaluated.remedial_implications: Child's horoscope is unformed; harsh ritual remedies are forbidden. Only gentle maternal blessings permitted.

teva_rules_evaluated.source_text_hi: बुध छठे रवि 1-5-11 टेवा बालिग ग्रह होता हो
teva_rules_evaluated.condition: Mercury in House 6 paired with Sun in House 1, 5, or 11
